content: UDP broadcast quirks: a host receives its own broadcasts back (loopback delivery of broadcast frames) - must filter by node_id, not by address; binding 0.0.0.0 on multi-homed hosts delivers broadcast once per eligible interface (duplicates); Go net.Listen sets SO_REUSEADDR automatically; 127.255.255.255 recommended for loopback broadcast tests; UDP has no built-in duplicate suppression - app must dedupe (sup-kv merge idempotence covers this). Wi-Fi: broadcast/multicast frames sent at lowest basic rate unacknowledged (loss-prone), APs commonly filter/convert broadcast (directed multicast, broadcast suppression, ~25% loss measured in AP mode on TI firmware); enterprise switches throttle broadcast (SSDP failures on Catalyst).
